purpose: Qualify corrected ordering of the physical top-boundary complementarity decision for an immediate-at-t0 ponding case. A dry-flux soil solve is not a prerequisite when the committed-state h_surface=0 face already proves the dry mode inadmissible.

r1_admission_rule.capacity_definition: q_cap0 is the qualified 5 cm surface-to-top-node face flux evaluated at h_surface=0 using the committed top-node head at t0.
r1_admission_rule.immediate_ponding_action: Do not execute a dry-flux soil trajectory. Keep committed time, heads, surface storage and ledgers unchanged and solve the same interval directly under the ponded/head branch.
r1_admission_rule.dry_admissible_action: Execute the existing dry-flux soil solve and retain all existing E3G mass/complementarity checks.
r1_admission_rule.physical_basis: With S=0, h_surface=0 is the limiting nonpositive surface-head state in this restricted boundary contract. If supply already exceeds that face capacity at the committed state, ponding starts at t0 rather than after a fictitious dry full-step trajectory.

frozen_R1_change_only: Change the ordering of initial boundary-mode admission in the immediate-ponding scenario.
Do not change constitutive physics, C1R tables, near-saturation face algorithms, 5 cm surface-face algorithms, solver tolerances, timestep, forcing, material set or comparison thresholds.
Do not relax the original E3G requirement or rewrite its failed evidence.

required_switch_scenario_evidence.B12_required_as_negative_control: B12 must also take initial admission even though its original E3G dry predictor was numerically valid; the R1 route may not be triggered by dry-solver failure.

architecture_checks.3_explicit_data_separation: Committed soil/surface state, forcing, boundary admission result, worker scratch and result diagnostics remain distinct.
architecture_checks.4_compact_persistent_state: No new persistent state is introduced.
architecture_checks.5_scratch_per_worker: Admission and nonlinear trial intermediates are worker-local.
architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: Mode selection happens before publication; bypassed or rejected work cannot mutate committed state.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: The interval remains generic and non-calendar based.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: All accepted physical paths retain the frozen exact mass checks without repair.
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: Boundary admission consumes the generic surface-face contract, not HeadCalc internals.
architecture_checks.22_no_headcalc_internals: No solver arrays are exposed to top-boundary policy.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: Surface capacity is physical face behavior; admission ordering is numerical/runtime policy.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: An already-inadmissible dry mode does not consume a wasted full nonlinear trajectory.
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: Reference surface face and reference soil trajectory remain available independently.
architecture_checks.26_diagnostics_runtime: Admission reason, q_supply, q_cap0, bypass count and solver counts are explicit.
architecture_checks.29_no_silent_dependencies: No day boundary, file format or MODFLOW dependency is introduced.

hard_nonclaims: No finite-time within-step ponding onset event localization is qualified by R1.
No pond-depletion head-to-flux switch is qualified.
No top soil-node h=0 or positive-head state is qualified.
No runoff with real soil state is qualified.
No response tangent across a boundary-mode switch is qualified.
No production runtime, MultiSWAP, groundwater or MODFLOW admission follows.
